description: This is a Java test class for the 'Allergen' model in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests using JUnit 5 to verify allergen-related behavior.

classes.name: AllergenTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class testing the behavior of the Allergen model in the OpenMRS core.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares test data by executing a dataset and setting a UUID for non-coded allergens.

methods.name: shouldEitherBeCodedOrFreeText
methods.description: Tests that an allergen can be either coded or a non-coded free text.

methods.name: assertCoded
methods.description: Asserts that an allergen is correctly identified as coded.

methods.name: assertNonCoded
methods.description: Asserts that an allergen is correctly identified as non-coded.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldReturnTrueForSameCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that two allergen objects with the same coded concept are identified as the same.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldReturnFalseForDifferentCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that two allergen objects with different coded concepts are identified as different.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldReturnTrueForSameNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that two allergen objects with the same non-coded allergen text are identified as the same.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldBeCaseInsensitiveForNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Checks that non-coded allergen comparison is case-insensitive.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldReturnFalseForDifferentNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that different non-coded allergen texts are correctly identified as different.
